Some(format!(\"Saved: {} = {}\", item.label, validated));\n                                                // Hot-reload will be triggered by ConfigWatcher\n                                            }\n                                            Err(e) => {\n                                                self.status_message = Some(format!(\"Error saving config: {}\", e));\n                                            }\n                                        }\n                                    }\n                                }\n                                Err(e) => {\n                                    self.status_message = Some(format!(\"Invalid value: {}\", e));\n                                    // Don't exit editing mode on validation error\n                                    self.mark_dirty();\n                                    return;\n                                }\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    self.config_menu_editing = false;\n                    self.config_menu_input.clear();\n                } else {\n                    // Enter editing mode for selected item\n                    if let Some(item) = items.get(self.config_menu_selected) {\n                        if item.editable {\n                            self.config_menu_editing = true;\n                            // Pre-populate input with current value (strip units for editing)\n                            self.config_menu_input = self.extract_edit_value(item);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                self.mark_dirty();\n            }\n            KeyCode::Char(c) if !self.config_menu_editing => {\n                // Navigation in non-editing mode\n                match c {\n                    'j'\n                        // Down with bounds checking\n                        if self.config_menu_selected < item_count.saturating_sub(1) => {\n                            self.config_menu_selected += 1;\n                            self.mark_dirty();\n                        }\n                    'k'\n                        // Up with bounds checking\n                        if self.config_menu_selected > 0 => {\n                            self.config_menu_selected -= 1;\n                            self.mark_dirty();\n                        }\n                    'q' => {\n                        self.show_config_menu = false;\n                        self.config_menu_input.clear();\n                        self.mark_dirty();\n                    }\n                    _ => {}\n                }\n            }\n            KeyCode::Char(c) if self.config_menu_editing => {\n                // Add character to input buffer\n                self.config_menu_input.push(c);\n                self.mark_dirty();\n            }\n            KeyCode::Backspace if self.config_menu_editing => {\n                self.config_menu_input.pop();\n                self.mark_dirty();\n            }\n            KeyCode::Up if !self.config_menu_editing\n                && self.config_menu_selected > 0 => {\n                    self.config_menu_selected -= 1;\n                    self.mark_dirty();\n                }\n            KeyCode::Down if !self.config_menu_editing\n                && self.config_menu_selected < item_count.saturating_sub(1) => {\n                    self.config_menu_selected += 1;\n                    self.mark_dirty();\n                }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Extract an editable value from a config item (strips units/formatting).\n    fn extract_edit_value(&self, item: &crate::config_menu::ConfigMenuItem) -> String {\n        let value = &item.value;\n\n        // Handle values with units (e.g., \"1000 ms\", \"60%\", \"$100.00\", \"30 min\")\n        match item.input_type {\n            crate::config_menu::ConfigInputType::Integer => {\n                // Extract just the number\n                value.split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or(value).to_string()\n            }\n            crate::config_menu::ConfigInputType::Float => {\n                // Remove currency symbol and extract number\n                value.trim_start_matches('$').split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or(value).to_string()\n            }\n            crate::config_menu::ConfigInputType::Text => {\n                value.to_string()\n            }\n            crate::config_menu::ConfigInputType::Select { .. } => {\n                // For select, return the current value as-is\n                value.to_string()\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Apply a config change from a menu item to the appropriate field.\n    ///\n    /// Returns true if the change was applied, false if the field wasn't recognized.\n    fn apply_menu_item_change(&mut self, menu_type: ConfigMenuType, label: &str, value: &str) -> bool {\n        match menu_type {\n            ConfigMenuType::Settings => {\n                match label {\n                    \"Refresh Interval\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            self.forge_config.dashboard.refresh_interval_ms = v;\n                            // Update the data poll interval immediately\n                            self.data_poll_interval = std::time::Duration::from_millis(v);\n                            return true;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"Max FPS\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            self.forge_config.dashboard.max_fps = v;\n                            return true;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"Default Layout\" => {\n                        self.forge_config.dashboard.default_layout = value.to_lowercase();\n                        return true;\n                    }\n                    \"Theme\" => {\n                        self.forge_config.theme.name = Some(value.to_string());\n                        return true;\n                    }\n                    \"Log Retention\" => {\n                        let days = match value {\n                            \"forever\" => 0,\n                            _ => value.trim_end_matches(\" days\").parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(7),\n                        };\n                        self.forge_config.dashboard.log_retention_days = days;\n                        return true;\n                    }\n                    _ => {}\n                }\n            }\n            ConfigMenuType::Budget => {\n                match label {\n                    \"Cost Tracking\" => {\n                        self.forge_config.cost_tracking.enabled = value == \"enabled\";\n                        return true;\n                    }\n                    \"Monthly Budget\" => {\n                        // Parse currency value (e.g., \"100.00\" or \"$100.00\")\n                        let clean = value.trim_start_matches('$');\n                        if let Ok(v) = clean.parse::<f64>() {\n                            self.forge_config.cost_tracking.monthly_budget_usd = Some(v);\n                            return true;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"Warning Threshold\" => {\n                        // Parse percentage value\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.trim_end_matches('%').parse::<u8>() {\n                            self.forge_config.cost_tracking.budget_warning_threshold = v;\n                            return true;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"Critical Threshold\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.trim_end_matches('%').parse::<u8>() {\n                            self.forge_config.cost_tracking.budget_critical_threshold = v;\n                            return true;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"Sonnet Cost/Input\" => {\n                        let clean = value.trim_start_matches('$').trim_end_matches(\"/1K\");\n                        if let Ok(v) = clean.parse::<f64>() {\n                            self.forge_config.cost_tracking.sonnet_cost_per_1k_input = v;\n                            return true;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"Sonnet Cost/Output\" => {\n                        let clean = value.trim_start_matches('$').trim_end_matches(\"/1K\");\n                        if let Ok(v) = clean.parse::<f64>() {\n                            self.forge_config.cost_tracking.sonnet_cost_per_1k_output = v;\n                            return true;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    _ => {}\n                }\n            }\n            ConfigMenuType::Worker => {\n                match label {\n                    \"Max Workers\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u64>() {\n                            self.forge_config.workers.max_workers = v.max(1);\n                            return true;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"Default Model\" => {\n                        self.forge_config.workers.default_model = value.to_lowercase();\n                        return true;\n                    }\n                    \"Worker Timeout\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.trim_end_matches(\" min\").parse::<i64>() {\n                            self.forge_config.auto_recovery.stuck_task_timeout_mins = v;\n                            return true;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    \"Auto-Recovery\" => {\n                        self.forge_config.auto_recovery.enabled = value == \"enabled\";\n                        return true;\n                    }\n                    \"Dead Worker Policy\" => {\n                        self.forge_config.auto_recovery.dead_worker_policy = value.to_string();\n                        return true;\n                    }\n                    \"Max Restart Attempts\" => {\n                        if let Ok(v) = value.parse::<u8>() {\n                            self.forge_config.auto_recovery.max_restart_attempts = v;\n                            return true;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    _ => {}\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        false\n    }\n\n    /// Check if an update is available by comparing source binary timestamp.\n    fn check_for_update(&mut self) {\n        use std::env;\n        use std::fs;\n\n        // Check every 10 seconds\n        if self.last_update_check.elapsed() < Duration::from_secs(10) {\n            return;\n        }\n        self.last_update_check = Instant::now();\n\n        let forge_src = env::var(\"FORGE_SRC\").unwrap_or_else(|_| \"/home/coder/forge\".to_string());\n\n        let source_binary = format!(\"{}/target/release/forge\", forge_src);\n        let installed_binary = env::current_exe()\n            .ok()\n            .or_else(|| {\n                env::var(\"HOME\")\n                    .ok()\n                    .map(|h| format!(\"{}/.cargo/bin/forge\", h).into())\n            })\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| \"forge\".into());\n\n        // Compare modification times\n        if let (Ok(source_meta), Ok(installed_meta)) = (\n            fs::metadata(&source_binary),\n            fs::metadata(&installed_binary),\n        ) {\n            if let (Ok(source_time), Ok(installed_time)) =\n                (source_meta.modified(), installed_meta.modified())\n            {\n                self.update_available = source_time > installed_time;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Trigger forge self-update from GitHub releases (non-blocking).\n    ///\n    /// Spawns an async task to:\n    /// 1. Check GitHub releases for latest version\n    /// 2. Download the new binary if update available\n    /// 3. Perform atomic swap\n    ///\n    /// Shows immediate visual feedback via the update_progress overlay.\n    #[cfg(feature = \"self-update\")]\n    fn trigger_update(&mut self) {\n        use std::thread;\n\n        // Prevent multiple concurrent updates\n        if self.update_in_progress {\n            self.status_message = Some(\"Update already in progress...\".to_string());\n            self.mark_dirty();\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Show immediate visual feedback\n        self.update_in_progress = true;\n        self.update_progress = UpdateProgress {\n            status: \"Checking for updates...\".to_string(),\n            percent: 0,\n            in_progress: true,\n        };\n        self.mark_dirty();\n\n        // Get current version\n        let current_version = env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\").to_string();\n\n        // Create channel for receiving result\n        let (tx_result, rx_result) = mpsc::channel();\n        self.update_result_rx = Some(rx_result);\n\n        // Spawn background thread with tokio runtime for async operations\n        thread::spawn(move || {\n            // Create a tokio runtime for this thread\n            let rt = match tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()\n                .enable_all()\n                .build()\n            {\n                Ok(rt) => rt,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    let _ = tx_result.send(UpdateResult::Failed(format!(\n                        \"Failed to create runtime: {}\",\n                        e\n                    )));\n                    return;\n                }\n            };\n\n            rt.block_on(async {\n                use forge_core::self_update::{check_for_update, perform_update, UpdateStatus};\n\n                // Check for updates\n                let status = match check_for_update(&current_version).await {\n                    Ok(status) => status,\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        let _ = tx_result.send(UpdateResult::Failed(format!(\n                            \"Failed to check for updates: {}\",\n                            e\n                        )));\n                        return;\n                    }\n                };\n\n                match status {\n                    UpdateStatus::UpToDate => {\n                        let _ = tx_result.send(UpdateResult::AlreadyUpToDate);\n                    }\n                    UpdateStatus::Available {\n                        current: _,\n                        latest: _,\n                        download_url,\n                        asset_size,\n                        expected_checksum,\n                    } => {\n                        // Perform the update without progress callback (download is typically fast)\n                        let result = perform_update(&download_url, asset_size, &expected_checksum, None).await;\n\n                        match result {\n                            Ok(forge_core::self_update::UpdateResult::Success { old_version, new_version }) => {\n                                let _ = tx_result.send(UpdateResult::Success {\n                                    old_version,\n                                    new_version,  // Use the version from the result\n                                });\n                            }\n                            Ok(forge_core::self_update::UpdateResult::AlreadyUpToDate) => {\n                                let _ = tx_result.send(UpdateResult::AlreadyUpToDate);\n                            }\n                            Ok(forge_core::self_update::UpdateResult::Failed(err)) => {\n                                let _ = tx_result.send(UpdateResult::Failed(err));\n                            }\n                            Err(e) => {\n                                let _ = tx_result.send(UpdateResult::Failed(format!(\n                                    \"Update failed: {}\",\n                                    e\n                                )));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            });\n        });\n    }\n\n    /// Trigger forge update fallback (when self-update feature is disabled).\n    #[cfg(not(feature = \"self-update\"))]\n    fn trigger_update(&mut self) {\n        self.status_message = Some(\"Self-update not available in this build.\".to_string());\n        self.mark_dirty();\n    }\n\n    /// Poll for update completion and progress (called from event loop).\n    fn poll_update_result(&mut self) {\n        if let Some(ref rx) = self.update_result_rx {\n            // Non-blocking check for result\n            if let Ok(result) = rx.try_recv() {\n                self.update_in_progress = false;\n                self.update_progress.in_progress = false;\n                self.update_result_rx = None;\n\n                match result {\n                    UpdateResult::Success {\n                        old_version,\n                        new_version,\n                    } => {\n                        self.status_message = Some(format!(\n                            \"Updated forge v{} -> v{}! Restarting...\",\n                            old_version, new_version\n                        ));\n                        self.update_available = false;\n                        self.update_progress.percent = 100;\n                        self.update_ready_for_restart = true;\n                        self.should_quit = true;\n                    }\n                    UpdateResult::AlreadyUpToDate => {\n                        self.status_message =\n                            Some(format!(\"Already running latest version v{}\", env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\")));\n                    }\n                    UpdateResult::Failed(err) => {\n                        self.status_message = Some(format!(\"Update failed: {}\", err));\n                    }\n                }\n                self.mark_dirty();\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Run the main application loop.\n    pub fn run(&mut self) -> AppResult<()> {\n        // Setup terminal\n        crossterm::terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;\n        let mut stdout = io::stdout();\n        crossterm::execute!(\n            stdout,\n            crossterm::terminal::EnterAlternateScreen,\n            crossterm::event::EnableMouseCapture\n        )?;\n        let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);\n        let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;\n\n        // Main loop\n        let result = self.run_inner(&mut terminal);\n\n        // Restore terminal\n        crossterm::terminal::disable_raw_mode()?;\n        crossterm::execute!(\n            terminal.backend_mut(),\n            crossterm::terminal::LeaveAlternateScreen,\n            crossterm::event::DisableMouseCapture\n        )?;\n        terminal.show_cursor()?;\n\n        // If an update was downloaded, restart with the new binary\n        // This replaces the current process via exec() - does not return on success\n        #[cfg(feature = \"self-update\")]\n        if self.update_ready_for_restart {\n            use tracing::info;\n            info!(\"Update ready, restarting with new binary...\");\n            eprintln!(\"\\n🔄 Restarting forge with the new version...\\n\");\n\n            match forge_core::restart_with_new_binary() {\n                Ok(()) => {\n                    // This should not be reached - exec() replaces the process\n                    unreachable!(\"exec() returned, which should never happen\");\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to restart with new binary: {}\", e);\n                    eprintln!(\"You may need to manually restart forge.\");\n                    // Return the original result since restart failed\n                    return result;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        result\n    }\n\n    /// Run the TUI in client mode, connecting to a FORGE server.\n    ///\n    /// This method starts the TUI application in client mode, where it connects\n    /// to a remote FORGE server via WebSocket for multi-user collaboration.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// * `config` - Client configuration with server URL and credentials\n    pub fn run_with_client(config: ClientConfig) -> AppResult<()> {\n        use tokio::runtime::Runtime;\n\n        info!(\"Starting FORGE in client mode, connecting to {}\", config.server_url);\n\n        // Create tokio runtime for async WebSocket client\n        let rt = Runtime::new()\n            .map_err(|e| Box::new(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e)))?;\n\n        // Create channels for communication with the background client task\n        let (request_tx, request_rx) = mpsc::channel::<ServerClientRequest>();\n        let (response_tx, response_rx) = mpsc::channel::<ServerClientMessage>();\n\n        // Clone config for the background task\n        let server_url = config.server_url.clone();\n        let user_id = config.user_id.clone();\n        let password = config.password.clone();\n\n        // Spawn background task for WebSocket client\n        rt.spawn(async move {\n            Self::run_client_background_task(server_url, user_id, password, request_rx, response_tx).await;\n        });\n\n        // Create app with client mode enabled\n        let mut app = Self::new();\n        app.server_client_tx = Some(request_tx);\n        app.server_client_rx = Some(response_rx);\n        app.server_url = Some(config.server_url.clone());\n\n        // Setup terminal\n        crossterm::terminal::enable_raw_mode()?;\n        let mut stdout = io::stdout();\n        crossterm::execute!(\n            stdout,\n            crossterm::terminal::EnterAlternateScreen,\n            crossterm::event::EnableMouseCapture\n        )?;\n        let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);\n        let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;\n\n        // Show connecting message\n        app.status_message = Some(format!(\"Connecting to {}...\", config.server_url));\n        app.mark_dirty();\n\n        // Main loop with server client polling\n        let result = app.run_loop_with_client(&mut terminal);\n\n        // Restore terminal\n        crossterm::terminal::disable_raw_mode()?;\n        crossterm::execute!(\n            terminal.backend_mut(),\n            crossterm::terminal::LeaveAlternateScreen,\n            crossterm::event::DisableMouseCapture\n        )?;\n        terminal.show_cursor()?;\n\n        result\n    }\n\n    /// Background task that runs the WebSocket client.\n    ///\n    /// This task handles all WebSocket communication with the FORGE server,\n    /// including authentication, receiving state updates, and sending requests.\n    async fn run_client_background_task(\n        server_url: String,\n        user_id: String,\n        password: String,\n        request_rx: Receiver<ServerClientRequest>,\n        response_tx: Sender<ServerClientMessage>,\n    ) {\n        use forge_server::client::ForgeClient;\n        use forge_server::protocol::{ClientMessage, ServerMessage};\n        use tokio::sync::mpsc;\n\n        info!(\"Client background task: connecting to {}\", server_url);\n\n        // Create async channels for tokio task\n        let (async_req_tx, mut async_req_rx) = mpsc::channel::<ServerClientRequest>(100);\n\n        // Forward sync requests to async channel\n        thread::spawn(move || {\n            while let Ok(req) = request_rx.recv() {\n                if async_req_tx.blocking_send(req).is_err() {\n                    warn!(\"Failed to forward request to async task\");\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        });\n\n        // Clone server_url for later use (since it's moved into ClientConfig)\n        let server_url_clone = server_url.clone();\n\n        // Create client\n        let client = ForgeClient::new(forge_server::client::ClientConfig {\n            server_url,\n            user_id,\n            password,\n        });\n\n        // Subscribe to state updates BEFORE connecting\n        let mut state_rx = client.subscribe();\n\n        // Spawn connection task (client.connect_and_run no longer consumes self)\n        let client_clone = client.clone();\n        let response_tx_clone = response_tx.clone();\n        tokio::spawn(async move {\n            if let Err(e) = client_clone.connect_and_run().await {\n                let _ = response_tx_clone.send(ServerClientMessage::ConnectionError {\n                    message: e.to_string(),\n                });\n            } else {\n                let _ = response_tx_clone.send(ServerClientMessage::Disconnected);\n            }\n        });\n\n        // Task to forward state updates from server to TUI\n        let response_tx_state = response_tx.clone();\n        tokio::spawn(async move {\n            while let Ok(server_msg) = state_rx.recv().await {\n                let tui_msg = match server_msg {\n                    ServerMessage::Welcome { session, server_info: _ } => {\n                        ServerClientMessage::Connected {\n                            session,\n                            server_url: server_url_clone.clone(),\n                        }\n                    }\n                    ServerMessage::StateUpdate(update) => {\n                        ServerClientMessage::StateUpdate {\n                            workers: update.workers,\n                            beads: update.beads,\n                            costs: update.costs,\n                        }\n                    }\n                    ServerMessage::UserJoined { user, display_name, role } => {\n                        ServerClientMessage::UserJoined { user, display_name, role }\n                    }\n                    ServerMessage::UserLeft { user } => {\n                        ServerClientMessage::UserLeft { user }\n                    }\n                    ServerMessage::BeadAssigned { bead_id, assigned_to, assigned_by } => {\n                        ServerClientMessage::BeadAssigned { bead_id, assigned_to, assigned_by }\n                    }\n                    ServerMessage::ChatMessage { from, message, timestamp } => {\n                        ServerClientMessage::ChatMessage { from, message, timestamp }\n                    }\n                    ServerMessage::Error { message } => {\n                        ServerClientMessage::ConnectionError { message }\n                    }\n                    ServerMessage::Ping | ServerMessage::WorkerChanged { .. } | ServerMessage::BeadChanged { .. } => {\n                        // These are handled internally or don't need TUI notification\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                };\n\n                if response_tx_state.send(tui_msg).is_err() {\n                    warn!(\"Failed to send message to TUI\");\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        });\n\n        // Handle incoming requests from TUI\n        while let Some(req) = async_req_rx.recv().await {\n            let client_msg = match req {\n                ServerClientRequest::AssignBead { bead_id, to } => {\n                    Some(ClientMessage::AssignBead { bead_id, to })\n                }\n                ServerClientRequest::UnassignBead { bead_id } => {\n                    Some(ClientMessage::UnassignBead { bead_id })\n                }\n                ServerClientRequest::SendChat { message } => {\n                    Some(ClientMessage::ChatMessage { message })\n                }\n                ServerClientRequest::UpdateView { view } => {\n                    Some(ClientMessage::UpdateView { view })\n                }\n                ServerClientRequest::SpawnWorker { model, count } => {\n                    Some(ClientMessage::SpawnWorker { model, count })\n                }\n                ServerClientRequest::KillWorker { worker_id } => {\n                    Some(ClientMessage::KillWorker { worker_id })\n                }\n            };\n\n            if let Some(msg) = client_msg {\n                // Use send_direct to send the message (works because connect_and_run no longer consumes self)\n                if let Err(e) = client.send_direct(msg).await {\n                    warn!(\"Failed to send message to server: {}\", e);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// The inner event loop with frame-rate limiting and server client support.\n    fn run_loop_with_client(&mut self, terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>) -> AppResult<()> {\n        // Memory update interval (every 60 frames = ~1 second at 60fps)\n        let mut memory_update_counter: u32 = 0;\n        const MEMORY_UPDATE_INTERVAL: u32 = 60;\n\n        while !self.should_quit {\n            let frame_start = Instant::now();\n\n            // Advance spinner animation when chat is pending\n            if self.chat_pending {\n                self.chat_spinner_frame = (self.chat_spinner_frame + 1) % 4;\n                self.mark_dirty(); // Ensure UI updates for spinner animation\n            }\n\n            // Poll for server client messages FIRST - in client mode, this is critical\n            self.poll_server_client_messages();\n\n            // Poll for chat responses - this is non-blocking and must happen\n            // frequently to ensure responsive chat UX\n            self.poll_chat_responses();\n\n            // Update streaming display if active\n            self.update_streaming();\n\n            // Poll for config hot-reload changes\n            self.poll_config_changes();\n\n            // Optimized data polling - only poll if interval elapsed\n            let needs_poll = self.last_poll_time.elapsed() >= self.data_poll_interval;\n            if needs_poll {\n                let data_changed = self.data_manager.poll_updates();\n                self.last_poll_time = Instant::now();\n\n                // Mark dirty if data actually changed\n                if data_changed {\n                    self.mark_dirty();\n                }\n\n                // Check for pending bell notifications and ring if needed\n                if self.data_manager.take_pending_bell() {\n                    crate::alert::AlertNotifier::ring_bell();\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Poll for chat responses again after data polling\n            self.poll_chat_responses();\n\n            // Update streaming display if active\n            self.update_streaming();\n\n            // Poll for update completion\n            self.poll_update_result();\n\n            // Check for updates periodically\n            self.check_for_update();\n\n            // Only draw if dirty or at minimum rate (timestamp updates every second)\n            let needs_redraw = self.take_dirty()\n                || self.last_timestamp_update.elapsed() >= TIMESTAMP_CACHE_DURATION;\n\n            // Measure render time\n            let render_start = Instant::now();\n            if needs_redraw {\n                terminal.draw(|frame| self.draw(frame))?;\n            }\n            let render_us = render_start.elapsed().as_micros() as u64;\n\n            // Calculate remaining time in frame for event handling\n            let elapsed = frame_start.elapsed();\n            let timeout_for_events = if elapsed < FRAME_DURATION {\n                FRAME_DURATION - elapsed\n            } else {\n                Duration::ZERO\n            };\n\n            // Handle events with adaptive timeout\n            let event_timeout = if timeout_for_events > Duration::ZERO {\n                timeout_for_events\n            } else {\n                // If frame took too long, use shorter timeout\n                Duration::from_millis(10)\n            };\n\n            if event::poll(event_timeout)? {\n                if let Event::Key(key) = event::read()? {\n                    self.data_manager.record_event();\n                    self.handle_key_event(key);\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Calculate event loop time (everything except render)\n            let frame_elapsed = frame_start.elapsed();\n            let event_loop_us = frame_elapsed.as_micros() as u64 - render_us;\n\n            // Record frame performance metrics\n            self.data_manager.record_frame_perf(event_loop_us, render_us);\n\n            // Periodically update memory usage\n            memory_update_counter += 1;\n            if memory_update_counter >= MEMORY_UPDATE_INTERVAL {\n                self.data_manager.update_memory();\n                self.data_manager.prune_perf_alerts();\n                memory_update_counter = 0;\n            }\n\n            // Frame-rate limiting: sleep if frame was too fast\n            if frame_elapsed < FRAME_DURATION {\n                let sleep_time = FRAME_DURATION - frame_elapsed;\n                std::thread::sleep(sleep_time);\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Poll for messages from the server client.\n    fn poll_server_client_messages(&mut self) {\n        // Take the receiver temporarily to avoid borrow checker issues\n        let rx = self.server_client_rx.take();\n        if let Some(rx) = rx {\n            loop {\n                match rx.try_recv() {\n                    Ok(msg) => {\n                        self.handle_server_client_message(msg);\n                        self.mark_dirty();\n                    }\n                    Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => break,\n                    Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => {\n                        self.is_server_connected = false;\n                        self.status_message = Some(\"Disconnected from server\".to_string());\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            // Put the receiver back\n            self.server_client_rx = Some(rx);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Handle a message from the server client.\n    fn handle_server_client_message(&mut self, msg: ServerClientMessage) {\n        match msg {\n            ServerClientMessage::Connected { session, server_url } => {\n                self.is_server_connected = true;\n                self.user_session = Some(session.clone());\n                self.server_url = Some(server_url.clone());\n                self.status_message = Some(format!(\n                    \"Connected to {} as {} ({})\",\n                    server_url, session.display_name, session.role\n                ));\n            }\n            ServerClientMessage::StateUpdate { workers, beads, costs } => {\n                // Update data manager with server state\n                self.data_manager.update_from_server_state(workers, beads, costs);\n            }\n            ServerClientMessage::UserJoined { user, display_name, role } => {\n                self.sessions_panel.add_user(user, display_name.clone(), role);\n                self.status_message = Some(format!(\"{} ({}) joined\", display_name, role));\n            }\n            ServerClientMessage::UserLeft { user } => {\n                self.sessions_panel.remove_user(&user);\n                self.status_message = Some(format!(\"{} left\", user));\n            }\n            ServerClientMessage::BeadAssigned { bead_id, assigned_to, assigned_by } => {\n                self.status_message = Some(format!(\n                    \"Bead {} assigned to {} by {}\",\n                    bead_id, assigned_to, assigned_by\n                ));\n            }\n            ServerClientMessage::ChatMessage { from, message, timestamp: _ } => {\n                // Add chat message from another user\n                self.chat_history.push(ChatExchange {\n                    user_query: format!(\"[{}] {}\", from, message),\n                    assistant_response: String::new(),\n                    timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),\n                    is_error: false,\n                    tool_calls: Vec::new(),\n                    side_effects: Vec::new(),\n                    confirmation: None,\n                    metadata: ResponseMetadata::default(),\n                    error_guidance: None,\n                });\n\n                // Keep only last 10 exchanges\n                if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {\n                    self.chat_history.remove(0);\n                }\n            }\n            ServerClientMessage::ConnectionError { message } => {\n                self.is_server_connected = false;\n                self.status_message = Some(format!(\"Connection error: {}\", message));\n            }\n            ServerClientMessage::Disconnected => {\n                self.is_server_connected = false;\n                self.status_message = Some(\"Disconnected from server\".to_string());\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Send a request to the server client.\n    fn send_server_client_request(&self, request: ServerClientRequest) {\n        if let Some(ref tx) = self.server_client_tx {\n            let _ = tx.send(request);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// The inner event loop with frame-rate limiting and optimized polling.\n    fn run_inner(&mut self, terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>) -> AppResult<()> {\n        // Memory update interval (every 60 frames = ~1 second at 60fps)\n        let mut memory_update_counter: u32 = 0;\n        const MEMORY_UPDATE_INTERVAL: u32 = 60;\n\n        while !self.should_quit {\n            let frame_start = Instant::now();\n\n            // Advance spinner animation when chat is pending\n            if self.chat_pending {\n                self.chat_spinner_frame = (self.chat_spinner_frame + 1) % 4;\n                self.mark_dirty(); // Ensure UI updates for spinner animation\n            }\n\n            // Poll for server client messages FIRST when in server/client mode\n            // This is critical for multi-user collaboration and state synchronization\n            if self.server_client_rx.is_some() {\n                self.poll_server_client_messages();\n            }\n\n            // Poll for chat responses FIRST - this is non-blocking and must happen\n            // frequently to ensure responsive chat UX. Don't let data polling block it.\n            self.poll_chat_responses();\n\n            // Update streaming display if active\n            self.update_streaming();\n\n            // Poll for config hot-reload changes\n            self.poll_config_changes();\n\n            // Optimized data polling - only poll if interval elapsed\n            let needs_poll = self.last_poll_time.elapsed() >= self.data_poll_interval;\n            if needs_poll {\n                let data_changed = self.data_manager.poll_updates();\n                self.last_poll_time = Instant::now();\n\n                // Mark dirty if data actually changed\n                if data_changed {\n                    self.mark_dirty();\n                }\n\n                // Check for pending bell notifications and ring if needed\n                if self.data_manager.take_pending_bell() {\n                    crate::alert::AlertNotifier::ring_bell();\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Poll for chat responses again after data polling in case a response\n            // arrived while we were doing the (potentially slow) data poll\n            self.poll_chat_responses();\n\n            // Update streaming display if active\n            self.update_streaming();\n\n            // Poll for update completion\n            self.poll_update_result();\n\n            // Check for updates periodically\n            self.check_for_update();\n\n            // Only draw if dirty or at minimum rate (timestamp updates every second)\n            let needs_redraw = self.take_dirty()\n                || self.last_timestamp_update.elapsed() >= TIMESTAMP_CACHE_DURATION;\n\n            // Measure render time\n            let render_start = Instant::now();\n            if needs_redraw {\n                terminal.draw(|frame| self.draw(frame))?;\n            }\n            let render_us = render_start.elapsed().as_micros() as u64;\n\n            // Calculate remaining time in frame for event handling\n            let elapsed = frame_start.elapsed();\n            let timeout_for_events = if elapsed < FRAME_DURATION {\n                FRAME_DURATION - elapsed\n            } else {\n                Duration::ZERO\n            };\n\n            // Handle events with adaptive timeout\n            let event_timeout = if timeout_for_events > Duration::ZERO {\n                timeout_for_events\n            } else {\n                // If frame took too long, use shorter timeout\n                Duration::from_millis(10)\n            };\n\n            if event::poll(event_timeout)? {\n                if let Event::Key(key) = event::read()? {\n                    self.data_manager.record_event();\n                    self.handle_key_event(key);\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Calculate event loop time (everything except render)\n            let frame_elapsed = frame_start.elapsed();\n            let event_loop_us = frame_elapsed.as_micros() as u64 - render_us;\n\n            // Record frame performance metrics\n            self.data_manager.record_frame_perf(event_loop_us, render_us);\n\n            // Periodically update memory usage\n            memory_update_counter += 1;\n            if memory_update_counter >= MEMORY_UPDATE_INTERVAL {\n                self.data_manager.update_memory();\n                self.data_manager.prune_perf_alerts();\n                memory_update_counter = 0;\n            }\n\n            // Frame-rate limiting: sleep if frame was too fast\n            if frame_elapsed < FRAME_DURATION {\n                let sleep_time = FRAME_DURATION - frame_elapsed;\n                std::thread::sleep(sleep_time);\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Draw the UI.\n    pub fn draw(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame) {\n        let area = frame.area();\n\n        // Update cached size if changed\n        if self.size_changed(area) {\n            self.update_cached_size(area);\n        }\n\n        // Main layout: header, content, footer\n        let chunks = Layout::default()\n            .direction(Direction::Vertical)\n            .constraints([\n                Constraint::Length(3), // Header\n                Constraint::Min(10),   // Content\n                Constraint::Length(2), // Footer\n            ])\n            .split(area);\n\n        self.draw_header(frame, chunks[0]);\n        self.draw_content(frame, chunks[1]);\n        self.draw_footer(frame, chunks[2]);\n\n        // Draw help overlay if active\n        if self.show_help {\n            self.draw_help_overlay(frame, area);\n        }\n\n        // Draw kill worker dialog if active\n        if self.show_kill_dialog {\n            self.draw_kill_dialog(frame, area);\n        }\n\n        // Draw confirmation dialog if active\n        if self.show_confirmation {\n            self.draw_confirmation_dialog(frame, area);\n        }\n\n        // Draw config menu overlay if active\n        if self.show_config_menu {\n            if let Some(menu_type) = self.config_menu_type {\n                let items = match menu_type {\n                    ConfigMenuType::Settings => build_settings_items(&self.forge_config),\n                    ConfigMenuType::Budget => build_budget_items(&self.forge_config),\n                    ConfigMenuType::Worker => build_worker_items(&self.forge_config),\n                };\n                let theme = self.theme_manager.current();\n                draw_config_menu(\n                    frame,\n                    crate::config_menu::ConfigMenuParams {\n                        area,\n                        menu_type,\n                        items: &items,\n                        selected: self.config_menu_selected,\n                        editing: self.config_menu_editing,\n                        edit_buffer: &self.config_menu_input,\n                        theme,\n                    },\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Draw task detail overlay if active\n        if self.show_task_detail {\n            self.draw_task_detail_overlay(frame, area);\n        }\n\n        // Draw alert detail overlay if active\n        if self.show_alert_detail {\n            self.draw_alert_detail_overlay(frame, area);\n        }\n\n        // Draw update notification banner if update available\n        if self.update_available {\n            self.draw_update_banner(frame, area);\n        }\n\n        // Draw network unreachable banner if network is down\n        if !self.network_available {\n            self.draw_network_banner(frame, area);\n        }\n\n        // Draw status message overlay if present\n        if let Some(ref msg) = self.status_message {\n            self.draw_status_message(frame, area, msg);\n        }\n\n        // Draw update in progress overlay (higher priority than status message)\n        if self.update_in_progress {\n            self.draw_update_progress_overlay(frame, area);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Draw the header bar with cached timestamp.\n    fn draw_header(&mut self, frame: &mut Frame, area: Rect) {\n        let now = self.get_cached_timestamp();\n        let theme = self.theme_manager.current();\n        let version = env!(\"CARGO_PKG_VERSION\");\n        let title = format!(\" FORGE v{} - {} \", version, self.current_view.title());\n        let title_len = title.len();\n\n        // Terminal dimensions display\n        let dimensions = format!(\"{}×{}\", frame.area().width, frame.area().height);\n\n        // Get alert badge for display\n        let alert_badge = self.data_manager.alert_badge();\n        let alert_text = if alert_badge.should_display() {\n            format!(\" {} \", alert_badge.format_compact())\n        } else {\n            String::new()\n        };\n        let alert_color = if alert_badge.critical > 0 {\n            theme.colors.status_error\n        } else {\n            theme.colors.status_warning\n        };\n\n        // Get unacknowledged errors for display\n        let unacknowledged = self.error_recovery.unacknowledged_errors();\n        let error_text = if !unacknowledged.is_empty() {\n            // Show count of unacknowledged errors\n            let count = unacknowledged.len();\n            format!(\"⚠️{} \", count)\n        } else {\n            String::new()\n        };\n\n        // Determine system status from real data\n        let paused_count = self.paused_workers.len();\n        let (status_text, status_color) = if let Some(err) = self.data_manager.init_error() {\n            (\n                format!(\"[Error: {}]\", truncate_status_error(err)),\n                theme.colors.status_error,\n            )\n        } else if !self.data_manager.is_ready() {\n            (\"[Loading...]\".to_string(), theme.colors.status_warning)\n        } else {\n            let counts = self.data_manager.worker_counts();\n            if counts.unhealthy() > 0 {\n                let paused_suffix = if paused_count > 0 {\n                    format!(\" ⏸{}\", paused_count)\n                } else {\n                    String::new()\n                };\n                (\n                    format!(\"[{} unhealthy{}]\", counts.unhealthy(), paused_suffix),\n                    theme.colors.status_warning,\n                )\n            } else if counts.total == 0 {\n                (\"[No workers]\".to_string(), theme.colors.text_dim)\n            } else if paused_count > 0 {\n                // Show paused count when there are paused workers\n                (\n                    format!(\"[{} workers ⏸{}]\", counts.total, paused_count),\n                    Color::Magenta,\n                )\n            } else {\n                (\n                    format!(\"[{} workers]\", counts.total),\n                    theme.colors.status_healthy,\n                )\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Calculate spacing to right-align timestamp, dimensions, alert badge, error indicator, and status\n        let right_content_len = now.len() + 2 + dimensions.len() + 2 + alert_text.len() + error_text.len() + status_text.len();\n        let spacing = area\n            .width\n            .saturating_sub(title_len as u16 + right_content_len as u16 + 2)\n            as usize;\n\n        let mut header_spans = vec![\n            Span::styled(\n                title,\n                Style::default()\n                    .fg(theme.colors.header)\n                    .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),\n            ),\n            Span::raw(\" \".repeat(spacing)),\n            Span::styled(now, Style::default().fg(theme.colors.text_dim)),\n            Span::raw(\"  \"),\n            Span::styled(dimensions, Style::default().fg(theme.colors.text_dim)),\n            Span::raw(\"  \"),\n        ];\n\n        // Add error indicator if there are unacknowledged errors\n        if !error_text.is_empty() {\n            header_spans.push(Span::styled(&error_text, Style::default().fg(theme.colors.status_error).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)));\n        }\n\n        // Add alert badge if there are alerts\n        if alert_badge.should_display() {\n            header_spans.push(Span::styled(&alert_text, Style::default().fg(alert_color).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)));\n        }\n\n        header_spans.push(Span::styled(status_text, Style::default().fg(status_color)));\n\n        let header = Paragraph::new(Line::from(header_spans))\n        .block(\n            Block::default()\n                .borders(Borders::ALL)\n                .border_style(Style::default().fg(theme.colors.border_dim)),\n        );\n\n        frame.render_widget(header, area);\n    }\n\n    /// Draw the main self.focus_panel == FocusPanel::ActivityLog,\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// Format the costs panel for the right column in ultra-wide mode.\n    fn format_costs_panel(&self) -> String {\n        use crate::cost_panel::{format_tokens, format_usd};\n\n        if !self.data_manager.is_ready() {\n            return \"Loading...\".to_string();\n        }\n\n        let data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;\n\n        if data.is_loading {\n            return \"Loading cost data...\".to_string();\n        }\n\n        if !data.has_data() {\n            return \"No cost data       }\n\n        let mut lines = Vec::new();\n\n        // Today's costs\n        let daily_alert = data.daily_alert();\n        lines.push(format!(\n            \"{} Today: {}\",\n fn draw_panel(&self, frame: &mut Frame, area: Rect, title: &str, content: &str, focused: bool) {\n        let theme = self.theme_manager.current();\n\n        // Enhanced focus indicator: \"▶\" arrow for focused (clearer than diamond), \"▪\" for unfocused\n        let focus_icon = if focused { \"▶\" } else { \"▪\" };\n\n        // Border type: Double border for focused (highly visible), Normal for unfocused\n        let border_type = if focused {\n            BorderType::Double\n        } else {\n            BorderType::Plain\n        };\n\n        // Border style: bright focus_highlight for focused, very dim for unfocused\n        let border_style = if focused {\n            Style::default()\n                .fg(theme.colors.focus_highlight)\n                .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)\n        } else {\n            Style::default().fg(theme.colors.border_dim)\n        };\n\n        // Title style: bold + bright + underlined for focused, dim for Modifier::UNDERLINED)\n        } else {\n            Style::default().fg(theme.colors.unfocused_text)\n        };\n\n        // Content style: bright for focused panels, significantly dimmed for .wrap(Wrap { trim: false });\n\n        frame.render_widget(panel, area);\n    }\n\n    /// Poll for data updates.    /// Draw a prominent overlay when update is in progress.\n    fn draw_update_progress_overlay(&self, frame: &mut Frame, area: Rect) {\n        // Create a centered overlay\n        let overlay_width = 60.min(area.width.saturating_sub(4));\n        let overlay_height = 7;\n        let overlay_x = (area.width.saturating_sub(overlay_width)) / 2;\n        let overlay_y = (area.height.saturating_sub(overlay_height)) / 2;\n\n        let overlay_area = Rect::new(overlay_x, overlay_y, overlay_width, overlay_height);\n\n        // Clear background\n        frame.render_widget(Clear, overlay_area);\n\n        // Status text from update_progress or status_message\n        let status_text = if !self.update_progress.status.is_empty() {\n            &self.update_progress.status\n        } else {\n            self.status_message\n                .as_deref()\n                .unwrap_or(\"Updating forge...\")\n        };\n\n        // Create progress bar\n        let progress_percent = self.update_progress.percent as usize;\n        let bar_width = (overlay_width as usize).saturating_sub(4);\n        let filled = (bar_width * progress_percent) / 100;\n        let empty = bar_width - filled;\n\n        let progress_bar = format!(\n            \"[{}{}] {}%\",\n            \"=\".repeat(filled),\n            \" \".repeat(empty),\n            progress_percent\n        );\n\n        let content = format!(\n            \"\\n  {}\\n\\n  {}\\n  \",\n            status_text, progress_bar\n        );\n\n        let overlay = Paragraph::new(content)\n            .style(\n                Style::default()\n                    .fg(Color::White)\n                    .bg(Color::Blue)\n                    .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),\n            )\n            .block(\n                Block::default()\n                    .borders(Borders::ALL)\n                    .border_style(Style::default().fg(Color::LightBlue))\n                    .title(Span::styled(\n                        \" Forge Update (Ctrl+U) \",\n                        Style::default()\n                            .fg(Color::White)\n                            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),\n                    )),\n            )\n            .alignment(ratatui::layout::Alignment::Left);\n\n        frame.render_widget(overlay, overlay_area);\n    }\n}\n\n/// Truncate an error message for status bar display.\nfn truncate_status_error(err: &str) -> String {\n    if err.len() <= 20 {\n test_priority_filter_keys_in_tasks_view() {\n        use crossterm::event::{KeyCode, KeyModifiers};\n\n        let mut app = App::new();\n\n        // Start in Overview, no filter\n        assert_eq!(app.current_view, View::Overview);\n        assert_eq!(app.priority_filter, None);\n\n        // Switch to Tasks view\n        app.switch_view(View::Tasks);\n        assert_eq!(app.current_view, View::Tasks);\n\n        // Press '0' - should set filter to P0\n        let key = KeyEvent::new(KeyCode::Char('0'), KeyModifiers::NONE);\n        app.handle_key_event(key);\n        assert_eq!(app.priority_filter, Some(0));\n\n        // Press '1' - should change filter to P1\n        let key = KeyEvent::new(KeyCode::Char('1'), KeyModifiers::NONE);\n        app.handle_key_event(key);\n        assert_eq!(app.priority_filter, Some(1));\n\n        // Press '1' again - should toggle off (clear filter)\n        let key = KeyEvent::new(KeyCode::Char('1'), KeyModifiers::NONE);\n        app.handle_key_event(key);\n        assert_eq!(app.priority_filter, None);\n\n        // Set filter to P2\n        let key = KeyEvent::new(KeyCode::Char('2'), KeyModifiers::NONE);\n        app.handle_key_event(key);\n        assert_eq!(app.priority_filter, Some(2));\n\n        // Press 'X' - should clear filter\n        let key = KeyEvent::new(KeyCode::Char('X'), KeyModifiers::NONE);\n        app.handle_key_event(key);\n        assert_eq!(app.priority_filter, None);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_priority_filter_keys_ignored_in_other_views() {\n        use crossterm::event::{KeyCode, KeyModifiers};\n\n        let mut app = App::new();\n\n        // Start in Overview\n        app.switch_view(View::Overview);\n        assert_eq!(app.priority_filter, None);\n\n        // Press '0' in Overview - should NOT set filter (it's treated as spawn Opus + '0')\n        let key = KeyEvent::new(KeyCode::Char('0'), KeyModifiers::NONE);\n        app.handle_key_event(key);\n\n        // Filter should still be None\n        assert_eq!(app.priority_filter, None);\n    }\n\n #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub cost_usd: Option<f64>,\n    /// Provider name\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub provider: String,\n}\n\n/// Generate actionable guidance for common errors.\nfn get_error_guidance(error_message: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let error_lower = error_message.to_lowercase();\n\n    // Config not found errors\n    if error_lower.contains(\"config\") && (error_lower.contains(\"not found\") || error_lower.contains(\"missing\")) {\n        return Some(\"Run 'forge init' to create a configuration file, or check that ~/.forge/config.yaml exists.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // API/authentication errors\n    if error_lower.contains(\"api key\") || error_lower.contains(\"authentication\") || error_lower.contains(\"unauthorized\") {\n        return Some(\"Check your API key in ~/.forge/config.yaml. Ensure the key is valid and not expired.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Rate limit errors\n    if error_lower.contains(\"rate limit\") || error_lower.contains(\"too many requests\") {\n        return Some(\"Wait a moment before sending more commands. Rate limits reset automatically.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Network unreachable (no internet)\n    if error_lower.contains(\"network unreachable\") || error_lower.contains(\"no route to host\") {\n        return Some(\"⚠️  Network unreachable. Check your internet connection and try again when online. Last known state is cached.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // DNS resolution failures\n    if error_lower.contains(\"dns\") || error_lower.contains(\"failed to lookup address\") || error_lower.contains(\"name or service not known\") {\n        return Some(\"⚠️  DNS resolution failed. Check DNS settings or try using 8.8.8.8 as your DNS server. Click 'r' to retry.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Connection timeout\n    if error_lower.contains(\"timeout\") {\n        return Some(\"⏱️  Request timed out. The server may be slow or unreachable. Click 'r' to retry or check status.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Generic connection/network errors\n    if error_lower.contains(\"connection\") || error_lower.contains(\"network\") {\n        return Some(\"⚠️  Connection failed. Check your internet connection. The API server may be temporarily unavailable. Click 'r' to retry.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Provider errors\n    if error_lower.contains(\"provider\") && error_lower.contains(\"not found\") {\n        return Some(\"Check that the provider is installed and available in your PATH. Run 'forge --help' for setup instructions.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Tool execution errors\n    if error_lower.contains(\"tool\") && error_lower.contains(\"failed\") {\n        return Some(\"The requested operation could not be completed. Check the tool output above for details.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Worker errors\n    if error_lower.contains(\"worker\") && (error_lower.contains(\"spawn\") || error_lower.contains(\"launch\")) {\n        return Some(\"Ensure you have sufficient system resources and the worker binary is available.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Context gathering errors\n    if error_lower.contains(\"context\") && error_lower.contains(\"failed\") {\n        return Some(\"The dashboard context could not be loaded. Try restarting the application.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Permission/access errors\n    if error_lower.contains(\"permission\") || error_lower.contains(\"access denied\") || error_lower.contains(\"forbidden\") {\n        return Some(\"You don't have permission for this action. Check your configuration and credentials.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // Resource not found errors (general)\n    if error_lower.contains(\"not found\") || error_lower.contains(\"does not exist\") {\n        return Some(\"The requested resource was not found. Verify the name and try again.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // JSON parsing errors\n    if error_lower.contains(\"json\") || error_lower.contains(\"parse\") || error_lower.contains(\"deserialize\") {\n        return Some(\"There was a problem processing the response. The server may have returned unexpected data.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    // IO errors\n    if error_lower.contains(\"io error\") || error_lower.contains(\"file\") && error_lower.contains(\"error\") {\n        return Some(\"A file system error occurred. Check file permissions and available disk space.\".to_string());\n    }\n\n    None\n}\n\n/// Result of an update operation.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug)]\npub enum UpdateResult {\n    /// Update completed successfully with version info\n    Success {\n        /// Previous version\n        old_version: String,\n        /// New version\n        new_version: String,\n    },\n    /// Update failed with an error message\n    Failed(String),\n    /// Already up to date\n    AlreadyUpToDate,\n}\n\n/// Progress information for update downloads.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]\npub struct UpdateProgress {\n    /// Current status message\n    pub status: String,\n    /// Download progress percentage (0-100)\n    pub percent: u8,\n    /// Whether the update is in progress\n    pub in_progress: ///\n    /// Returns None if config is missing or initialization fails.\n    /// Errors are logged but don't prevent app startup.\n    fn init_chat_backend_with_worker_spawner(\n        _worker_runtime: &tokio::runtime::Runtime,\n        _worker_launcher: &WorkerLauncher,\n    ) -> Option<ChatBackend> {\n        use forge_chat::config::{AuditConfig, ConfirmationConfig, return None;\n            }\n        };\n\n        info!(\n            \"⏱️ Initializing chat backend from {}\",\n            config_path.display()\n        );\n\n        if !config_path.exists() {\n            warn!(\n                \"⏱️ Chat config not found at {} (took {:?})\",\n                config_path.display(),\n                start.elapsed()\n            );\n            return None;\n        }\n\n        let read_start = std::time::Instant::now();\n        let config_str = match std::fs::read_to_string(&config_path) {\n            Ok(s) => s,\n            Err(e) => {\n                error!(\n                    \"⏱️ Failed to read chat config: {} (took {:?})\",\n                    e,\n                    start.elapsed()\n                );\n                return None;\n            }\n        };\n        info!(\"⏱️ Config file read in {:?}\", read_start.elapsed());\n\n        // Parse the full config YAML\n        let parse_start = std::time::Instant::now();\n        let yaml: serde_yaml::Value = match serde_yaml::from_str(&config_str) {\n            Ok(v) => v,\n            Err(e) => {\n                warn!(\n                    \"⏱️ Failed to parse config YAML: {} (took {:?})\",\n                    e,\n                    start.elapsed()\n                );\n                return None;\n            }\n        };\n        info!(\"⏱️ YAML parsed in {:?}\", parse_start.elapsed());\n\n        // Extract chat_backend section\n        let chat_backend = yaml.get(\"chat_backend\")?;\n        let command = chat_backend.get(\"command\")?.as_str()?;\n\n        // Read optional args (not required — providers may handle args internally)\n        let args: Vec<String> = chat_backend\n            .get(\"args\")\n            .and_then(|v| v.as_sequence())\n            .map(|seq| {\n                seq.iter()\n                    .filter_map(|v| v.as_str().map(|s| s.to_string()))\n                    .collect()\n            })\n            .unwrap_or_default();\n\n        // Read model (optional, defaults to \"sonnet\")\n        let model = chat_backend\n            .get(\"model\")\n            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n            .unwrap_or(\"sonnet\")\n            .to_string();\n\n        // Determine provider: explicit `provider` field takes precedence; fall back to\n        // inferring from `command` for backwards compatibility (opencode → opencode,\n        // anything else → claude-cli).\n        let provider_name = chat_backend\n            .get(\"provider\")\n            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| {\n                if command == \"opencode\" {\n                    \"opencode\"\n                } else {\n                    \"claude-cli\"\n                }\n            });\n\n        info!(\"⏱️ Using provider: {}\", provider_name);\n\n        // Warn about command/provider field mismatches before delegating to factory.\n        match provider_name {\n            \"opencode\" if command != \"opencode\" => {\n                warn!(\n                    \"Provider is 'opencode' but command is '{}' — using command as binary path\",\n                    command\n                );\n            }\n            \"claude-cli\" if command == \"opencode\" => {\n                warn!(\n                    \"Provider is 'claude-cli' but command is 'opencode' — this may not work as \\\n                     expected.      let model_aliases = chat_backend\n            .get(\"model_aliases\")\n            .and_then(|v| v.as_mapping())\n            .map(|m| {\n                m.iter()\n                    .filter_map(|(k, v)| {\n                        let key = k.as_str()?.to_string();\n                        let val = v.as_str()?.to_string();\n                        Some((key, val))\n                    })\n                    .collect::<std::collections::HashMap<String, String>>()\n            });\n\n        // Use the factory to build the ProviderConfig from the provider name string.\n        let provider_config = match ChatProviderFactory::create_config(\n            provider_name,\n            command,\n            &model,\n            args,\n            model_aliases,\n        ) {\n            Ok(config) => config,\n            Err(e) => {\n                error!(\"Failed to create provider config: {}\", e);\n                return None;\n            }\n        };\n\n        let std::env::var(\"FORGE_WORKSPACE\")\n            .map(std::path::PathBuf::from)\n            .unwrap_or_else(|_| std::path::PathBuf::from(&home).join(\"forge\"));\n\n        // Create RealWorkerSpawner Arc::new(forge_chat::spawner::NoOpWorkerSpawner)\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Initialize backend (async, but we block here during startup)\n        let runtime_start = std::time::Instant::now();\n        match tokio::runtime::Runtime::new() {\n            Ok(rt) => {\n                info!(\n                    \"⏱️ Created tokio runtime for chat backend in                            \"⏱️ ✅ Chat backend initialized successfully in {:?} (total: {:?})\",\n                            backend_start.elapsed(),\n                            start.elapsed()\n                        );\n                        Some(backend)\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        error!(\n                            \"⏱️ ❌ Failed to }\n                }\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                error!(\n                    \"⏱️ ❌ Failed to create tokio runtime: {} (took {:?})\",\n                    e,\n                    start.elapsed()\n                );\n                None\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the current view.\n    pub fn current_view(&self) -> View {\n        self.current_view\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the current focus panel.\n    pub fn focus_panel(&self) -> FocusPanel {\n        self.focus_panel\n    }\n\n    /// Returns whether the app should quit.\n    pub fn should_quit(&self) -> bool {\n        self.should_quit\n    }\n\n    /// Returns whether help overlay is visible.\n    pub fn show_help(&self) -> bool {\n        self.show_help\n    }\n\n    /// Returns whether kill dialog is visible.\n    pub fn show_kill_dialog(&self) -> bool {\n        self.show_kill_dialog\n    }\n\n    /// Returns whether FORGE is running in client/server mode (vs redraw).\n    fn mark_dirty(&mut self) {\n        self.dirty = true;\n    }\n\n    /// Handle local chat commands (commands processed by TUI, not sent to backend).\n    ///\n    /// Returns true if the command was handled locally, false if it should be sent to backend.\n    fn handle_chat_command(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {\n        let trimmed = query.trim();\n\n        // Check for slash commands\n        if !trimmed.starts_with('/') {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Parse command and arguments\n        let parts: Vec<&str> = trimmed[1..].splitn(2, ' ').collect();\n        let command = parts[0].to_lowercase();\n        let args = parts.get(1).map(|s| s.trim());\n\n        match command.as_str() {\n            \"save\" => {\n                self.save_chat_history();\n                true\n            }\n            \"load\" => {\n                self.load_chat_history();\n                true\n            }\n            \"export\" => {\n                let path = args.map(std::path::PathBuf::from);\n                self.export_chat_history(path);\n                true\n            }\n            \"clear\" => {\n                self.chat_history.clear();\n                self.chat_scroll_offset = 0;\n                self.status_message = Some(\"Chat history cleared\".to_string());\n                info!(\"Chat history cleared by user command\");\n                true\n            }\n            \"history\" => {\n                // Show history info\n                let count = self.chat_history.len();\n                let msg = if count == 0 {\n                    \"No chat history. Use /load to restore previous sessions.\".to_string()\n                } else {\n                    format!(\"Chat history: {} exchanges in current session\", count)\n                };\n                self.status_message = Some(msg);\n                true\n            }\n            \"stats\" => {\n                self.show_history_stats();\n                true\n            }\n            \"help\" => {\n                // Show available commands\n                let help_text = \"Commands: /save /load /export [path] /clear /history /stats /help\";\n                self.chat_history.push(ChatExchange {\n                    user_query: \"/help\".to_string(),\n                    assistant_response: help_text.to_string(),\n                    timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format(\"%H:%M:%S\").to_string(),\n                    is_error: false,\n                    tool_calls: vec![],\n                    side_effects: vec![],\n                    confirmation: None,\n                    metadata: ResponseMetadata::default(),\n                    error_guidance: None,\n                });\n                // Limit history to 10 exchanges\n                if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {\n                    self.chat_history.remove(0);\n                }\n                true\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // Unknown slash command - let it go to the backend\n                false\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Handle a query through the local fast path, without contacting the chat provider.\n    fn handle_fast_path_query(&mut self, query: &str) -> bool {\n        let result = self\n            .fast_path_matcher\n            .as_ref()\n            .map(|matcher| matcher.match_query(query));\n        let action = match result {\n            Some(forge_chat::FastPathResult::Handled(action)) => action,\n            _ => return false,\n        };\n\n        let response_text = match action {\n            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowCosts => {\n                self.switch_view(View::Costs);\n                let cost_data = &self.data_manager.cost_data;\n                if
