crate::cost_panel::format_usd(cost_data.today_total()),\n                        cost_data.today_calls(),\n                        crate::cost_panel::format_tokens(cost_data.today_tokens()),\n                    )\n                } else {\n                    \"Costs view opened; today's spending is not available yet.\".to_string()\n                }\n            }\n            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowWorkers => {\n                self.switch_view(View::Workers);\n                format!(\n                    \"Workers view opened ({} workers).\",\n                    self.data_manager.worker_data.total_worker_count()\n                )\n            }\n            forge_chat::FastPathAction::ShowTasks { priority } => {\n                self.priority_filter = priority;\n                self.task_search_mode = false;\n                self.task_search_query.clear();\n                self.switch_view(View::Tasks);\n                let count = self.data_manager.bead_manager.task_count_filtered(priority);\n                match priority {\n                    Some(priority) => format!(\"Showing P{} tasks ({} ready).\", priority, count),\n                    None => format!(\"Tasks view opened ({} ready).\", count),\n                }\n            }\n            forge_chat::FastPathAction::SwitchView(target) => {\n                let view = match target {\n                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Overview => View::Overview,\n                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Workers => View::Workers,\n                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Tasks => View::Tasks,\n                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Costs => View::Costs,\n                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Alerts => View::Alerts,\n                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Logs => View::Logs,\n                    forge_chat::ViewTarget::Chat => View::Chat,\n                };\n                self.switch_view(view);\n                format!(\"{} view opened.\", view.title())\n            }\n        };\n\n        let exchange = ChatExchange {\n            user_query: query.to_string(),\n            assistant_response: response_text.clone(),\n            timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format(\"%H:%M:%S\").to_string(),\n            is_error: false,\n            tool_calls: vec![],\n            side_effects: vec![],\n            confirmation: None,\n            metadata: ResponseMetadata {\n                provider: \"local-fast-path\".to_string(),\n                ..ResponseMetadata::default()\n            },\n            error_guidance: None,\n        };\n        self.persist_chat_exchange(&exchange);\n        self.chat_history.push(exchange);\n        if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {\n            self.chat_history.remove(0);\n        }\n        self.status_message = Some(response_text);\n        self.mark_dirty();\n        true\n    }\n\n    /// Save current chat history to disk.\n    fn save_chat_history(&mut self) {\n        let history_manager = match &self.history_manager {\n            Some(hm) => hm,\n            None => {\n                self.status_message = Some(\"History manager not initialized\".to_string());\n                return;\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Convert ChatExchange to HistoryEntry\n        let entries: Vec<forge_chat::HistoryEntry> = self\n            .chat_history\n            .iter()\n            .map(|exchange| forge_chat::HistoryEntry {\n                timestamp: exchange.timestamp.clone(),\n                user_query: exchange.user_query.clone(),\n                assistant_response: exchange.assistant_response.clone(),\n                is_error: exchange.is_error,\n                metadata: Some(forge_chat::HistoryMetadata {\n                    duration_ms: exchange.metadata.duration_ms,\n                    cost_usd: exchange.metadata.cost_usd,\n                    provider: exchange.metadata.provider.clone(),\n                }),\n                tool_calls: exchange\n                    .tool_calls\n                    .iter()\n                    .map(|tc| forge_chat::HistoryToolCall {\n                        name: tc.name.clone(),\n                        success: tc.success,\n                        message: Some(tc.message.clone()),\n                    })\n                    .collect(),\n                session_id: None,\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        // Save in background (avoid blocking UI)\n        let history_path = history_manager.history_path().clone();\n        let session_id = history_manager.session_id().to_string();\n        std::thread::spawn(move || {\n            use std::io::Write;\n            match std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n                .create(true)\n                .append(true)\n                .open(&history_path)\n            {\n                Ok(mut file) => {\n                    let mut saved = 0;\n                    for mut entry in entries {\n                        entry.session_id = Some(session_id.clone());\n                        if let Ok(json) = serde_json::to_string(&entry) {\n                            if writeln!(file, \"{}\", json).is_ok() {\n                                saved += 1;\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                    info!(\"Saved {} entries to history\", saved);\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    error!(\"Failed to save history: {}\", e);\n                }\n            }\n        });\n\n        self.status_message = Some(format!(\n            \"Saved {} exchanges to history\",\n            self.chat_history.len()\n        ));\n    }\n\n    /// Load chat history from disk.\n    fn load_chat_history(&mut self) {\n        let history_manager = match &self.history_manager {\n            Some(hm) => hm,\n            None => {\n                self.status_message = Some(\"History manager not initialized\".to_string());\n                return;\n            }\n        };\n\n        let history_path = history_manager.history_path().clone();\n\n        // Load history synchronously (quick operation)\n        if !history_path.exists() {\n            self.status_message = Some(\"No saved history found\".to_string());\n            return;\n        }\n\n        match std::fs::File::open(&history_path) {\n            Ok(file) => {\n                use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader};\n                let reader = BufReader::new(file);\n                let mut loaded = 0;\n\n                // Load last 10 entries\n                let mut entries: Vec<forge_chat::HistoryEntry> = Vec::new();\n                for line in reader.lines().map_while(Result::ok) {\n                    if line.trim().is_empty() {\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                    if let Ok(entry) = serde_json::from_str::<forge_chat::HistoryEntry>(&line) {\n                        entries.push(entry);\n                    }\n                }\n\n                // Take last 10 entries\n                let start = entries.len().saturating_sub(10);\n                for entry in &entries[start..] {\n                    self.chat_history.push(ChatExchange {\n                        user_query: entry.user_query.clone(),\n                        assistant_response: entry.assistant_response.clone(),\n                        timestamp: entry.timestamp.clone(),\n                        is_error: entry.is_error,\n                        tool_calls: entry\n                            .tool_calls\n                            .iter()\n                            .map(|tc| ToolCallInfo {\n                                name: tc.name.clone(),\n                                success: tc.success,\n                                message: tc.message.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                            })\n                            .collect(),\n                        side_effects: vec![],\n                        confirmation: None,\n                        metadata: entry.metadata.as_ref().map(|m| ResponseMetadata {\n                            duration_ms: m.duration_ms,\n                            cost_usd: m.cost_usd,\n                            provider: m.provider.clone(),\n                        }).unwrap_or_default(),\n                        error_guidance: None,\n                    });\n                    loaded += 1;\n                }\n\n                // Trim to 10 entries if we loaded more than we had room for\n                while self.chat_history.len() > 10 {\n                    self.chat_history.remove(0);\n                }\n\n                self.status_message = Some(format!(\"Loaded {} exchanges from history\", loaded));\n                info!(\"Loaded {} entries from history\", loaded);\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                self.status_message = Some(format!(\"Failed to load history: {}\", e));\n                error!(\"Failed to load history: {}\", e);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Export chat history to a file.\n    fn export_chat_history(&mut self, path: Option<std::path::PathBuf>) {\n        let history_manager = match &self.history_manager {\n            Some(hm) => hm,\n            None => {\n                self.status_message = Some(\"History manager not initialized\".to_string());\n                return;\n            }\n        };\n\n        let export_path = path.unwrap_or_else(|| {\n            dirs::home_dir()\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from(\".\"))\n                .join(\"chat-export.json\")\n        });\n\n        let history_path = history_manager.history_path().clone();\n\n        // Load and export in background\n        let export_path_clone = export_path.clone();\n        std::thread::spawn(move || {\n            // Load all entries\n            let entries: Vec<forge_chat::HistoryEntry> = if history_path.exists() {\n                use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader};\n                match std::fs::File::open(&history_path) {\n                    Ok(file) => {\n                        let reader = BufReader::new(file);\n                        reader\n                            .lines()\n                            .map_while(std::result::Result::ok)\n                            .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())\n                            .filter_map(|line| serde_json::from_str(&line).ok())\n                            .collect()\n                    }\n                    Err(_) => Vec::new(),\n                }\n            } else {\n                Vec::new()\n            };\n\n            // Export as pretty JSON\n            match serde_json::to_string_pretty(&entries) {\n                Ok(json) => {\n                    if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&export_path_clone, json) {\n                        error!(\"Failed to write export file: {}\", e);\n                    } else {\n                        info!(\"Exported {} entries to {}\", entries.len(), export_path_clone.display());\n                    }\n                }\n                Err(e) => {\n                    error!(\"Failed to serialize history: {}\", e);\n                }\n            }\n        });\n\n        self.status_message = Some(format!(\"Exporting history to {}\", export_path.display()));\n    }\n\n    /// Show history statistics.\n    fn show_history_stats(&mut self) {\n        let history_manager = match &self.history_manager {\n            Some(hm) => hm,\n            None => {\n                self.status_message = Some(\"History manager not initialized\".to_string());\n                return;\n            }\n        };\n\n        let history_path = history_manager.history_path().clone();\n\n        // Calculate stats\n        if !history_path.exists() {\n            self.chat_history.push(ChatExchange {\n                user_query: \"/stats\".to_string(),\n                assistant_response: \"No saved history. Session has {} exchanges.\".replace(\"{}\", &self.chat_history.len().to_string()),\n                timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format(\"%H:%M:%S\").to_string(),\n                is_error: false,\n                tool_calls: vec![],\n                side_effects: vec![],\n                confirmation: None,\n                metadata: ResponseMetadata::default(),\n                error_guidance: None,\n            });\n            if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {\n                self.chat_history.remove(0);\n            }\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Load and calculate stats\n        use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader};\n        match std::fs::File::open(&history_path) {\n            Ok(file) => {\n                let reader = BufReader::new(file);\n                let entries: Vec<forge_chat::HistoryEntry> = reader\n                    .lines()\n                    .map_while(std::result::Result::ok)\n                    .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())\n                    .filter_map(|line| serde_json::from_str(&line).ok())\n                    .collect();\n\n                let total = entries.len();\n                let errors = entries.iter().filter(|e| e.is_error).count();\n                let total_cost: f64 = entries\n                    .iter()\n                    .filter_map(|e| e.metadata.as_ref()?.cost_usd)\n                    .sum();\n                let sessions: std::collections::HashSet<_> = entries\n                    .iter()\n                    .filter_map(|e| e.session_id.as_ref())\n                    .collect();\n\n                let stats_text = format!(\n                    \"History Stats:\\n• Total exchanges: {}\\n• Errors: {} ({:.1}%)\\n• Sessions: {}\\n• Est. cost: ${:.4}\\n• Current session: {} exchanges\",\n                    total,\n                    errors,\n                    if total > 0 { (errors as f64 / total as f64) * 100.0 } else { 0.0 },\n                    sessions.len(),\n                    total_cost,\n                    self.chat_history.len()\n                );\n\n                self.chat_history.push(ChatExchange {\n                    user_query: \"/stats\".to_string(),\n                    assistant_response: stats_text,\n                    timestamp: chrono::Local::now().format(\"%H:%M:%S\").to_string(),\n                    is_error: false,\n                    tool_calls: vec![],\n                    side_effects: vec![],\n                    confirmation: None,\n                    metadata: ResponseMetadata::default(),\n                    error_guidance: None,\n                });\n                if self.chat_history.len() > 10 {\n                    self.chat_history.remove(0);\n                }\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                self.status_message = Some(format!(\"Failed to read history: {}\", e));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Persist a   }\n\n    /// Get or create the current user session.\n    ///\n    /// For local mode, creates a default session with Admin role.\n    /// For server mode, returns the session from the server /// Get layout mode with caching.\n    fn get_layout_mode(&mut self, width: u16) -> LayoutMode {\n        if self.last_terminal_width != width || self.cached_layout_mode.is_none() {\n /// Check if terminal size changed.\n    fn size_changed(&self, area: Rect) -> bool {\n        match self.cached_size {\n            Some(cached) => cached.width != area.width || cached.height != area.height,\n            None => true,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Update cached terminal size.\n    fn update_cached_size(&mut self, area: Rect) {\n        self.cached_size = Some(area);\n    }\n\n    /// Switch to a specific view.\n    pub fn switch_view(&mut self, view: View) {\n        if self.current_view != view {\n            self.previous_view = Some(self.current_view);\n            self.current_view = view;\n            self.scroll_offset = 0;\n            self.mark_dirty();\n\n            // Set appropriate default focus for the view\n            self.focus_panel = match view {\n                View::Overview => FocusPanel::WorkerPool,\n                View::Workers => FocusPanel::WorkerPool,\n                View::Tasks => FocusPanel::TaskQueue,\n                View::Costs => FocusPanel::CostBreakdown,\n                View::Metrics => FocusPanel::MetricsCharts,\n                View::Perf => FocusPanel::PerfCharts,\n                View::Logs => FocusPanel::ActivityLog,\n                View::Subscriptions => FocusPanel::Subscriptions,\n                View::Alerts => FocusPanel::None,\n                View::Routing => FocusPanel::None,\n                View::Chat => FocusPanel::ChatInput,\n                View::Sessions => FocusPanel::SessionsList,\n            };\n\n            // Update input handler for chat mode\n            self.input_handler.set_chat_mode(view == View::Chat);\n            // Update input handler with current view for view-specific key handling\n            self.input_handler.set_current_view(view);\n\n            self.status_message = Some(format!(\n                \"{} (Press {} to return here)\",\n                view.title(),\n                view.hotkey()\n            ));\n\n            // Notify server of view change when connected\n            self.send_server_client_request(ServerClientRequest::UpdateView {\n                view: view.to_string(),\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Go to the next view in the cycle.\n    pub fn next_view(&mut self) {\n        let next = self.current_view.next();\n        self.switch_view(next);\n    }\n\n    /// Go to the previous view in the cycle.\n    pub fn prev_view(&mut self) {\n        let prev = self.current_view.prev();\n        self.switch_view(prev);\n    }\n\n    /// Go back to the previous view (if any).\n    pub fn go_back(&mut self) {\n        if let Some(prev) = self.previous_view.take() {\n            self.switch_view(prev);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Poll for chat responses from background thread.\n    fn
